title: gnaphalium mackayi
intro: Gnaphalium mackayi, commonly known as Cape chamomile, is a plant species native to South Africa. It has been used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium mackayi include acting as a nervine sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and diterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
